page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head and page number at the top. No notes in the margins. Small stray marks lie in the left margin, not printed text.

main_text.p: interpretationibus non satis intelligentes, dimisso conuentu, interdum humaniter me appellarint: cumque pluribus verbis thesiū propositiones damnassent, tum etiam auctoritatem praeceptoris sui[?] Franc. Duareni, iuris consulti hac ætate clari in primis, & eruditi, adiungebant. Accidit autem eo tempore, cum Duareni librū de verb.oblig.quidam de industria mihi attulisset, ut eū locum in quo thesium propositiones damnat, legerem, ut mihi optimum illum & doctissimum librum peruolu-tanti, notae quaedam numero-

page.notes: Page number read as "86", but the digit is partly faded and may be "36". "sui" is read as "fui" with [?]. The running head's second part is an ornamental, heavily inked word that cannot be read. The marks at the left margin are stains or stray marks, not text. "numero-" continues on the next page as "ro-". Long s rendered as plain s throughout.
